widgets_values:
force_rate(强制帧率)：默认为每秒16帧，如果希望动作更流畅可以设置为24或往上。

frame_load_cap：读取的总帧数，视频的时长就是通过这个来控制。

视频时长= 总帧数 / 强制帧率 。 比如 10秒 = 160帧 / 16 

skip_first_frames：跳过前面的X帧

width = 视频宽度
height = 视频高度
插帧。就是提高你视频的帧率让其更流畅。

Use MultiImageLoader to batch-upload reference images, then upload one driving video before queueing. Use the Frame Interpolation group switch to enable or bypass GIMM interpolation.
Relighting LoRA is for replacement mode and is intentionally not enabled in this animation workflow.

The video shows the girl from the reference image performing the same dance motion as the source video. She is an anime-style girl with black twin-tail hair, straight bangs, pale skin, dark eyes, and a cheerful open-mouth smile. She wears the same black choker, oversized dark sweatshirt with a white heart and red dripping design, plaid pleated skirt, black thigh-high socks, and black loafers. Her full body remains visible from head to toe while she dances, including both legs and both shoes. She has no tail and no animal ears anywhere in the video. Her hairstyle, outfit, colors, and character identity remain consistent throughout the video, with no color shift, no outfit change, and no character redesign. The background stays clean and simple.
